scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix runner ci
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:runner
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
